answer_1.quote: We propose a novel End-to-End GPT-based model OmniFlatten for full-duplex speech conversation. OmniFlatten is capable of effectively learning the complex behaviors inherent to natural conversations and facilitates human-like interactions with low latency.

answer_2.quote: For TTS evaluation, ... compute Word Error Rate (WER) for English datasets and Character Error Rate (CER) for Chinese datasets. ... using UTMOS ... Assistant Turn-taking Acc@k ... User Turn-taking Acc@k ... Response Time.

answer_3.quote: Prior works demonstrate that competitive text-based LLMs can be reliable evaluators for various natural language generation tasks ... we evaluate the full-duplex dialogue capabilities of OmniFlatten, by prompting a competitive text LLM to evaluate the semantics of dialogues and assign a score ... The specific prompt we use for LLM scoring is detailed in Appendix A. We carefully design the prompt to evaluate fluency and coherence of the predicted assistant response.
methods: LLM scoring on a scale of 1 to 10
